name: a playzone administrator runs the arcade from the central computer: the cabinets work while it is on duty and a bored resident plays one, and they are dark once it has gone home

steps.note: a playzone under the open sky: the central computer at (5, 3) between three arcade cabinets at (3, 3), (7, 3) and (9, 3), all four on wiring from a box at (1, 4) fed by a generator at (1, 5). A crate stands on the box, so nobody can get to it and no electrician is hired for it. A world opens at 08:00 on day 1, a Monday
the computer and the cabinets are powered like any screen

one central computer is four workplaces, a day shift and an evening shift each for two groups on alternate days: the first arrival is the first group's day administrator, Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday

steps.expect_log: was hired as a playzone administrator at the playzone computer at 5, 3, 10:00-16:00

steps.note: the second would be the other group's day administrator: let go, it is somebody to play
the player needs nothing but something to do; the administrator, nothing at all

steps.expect_text: on the way to the playzone

steps.note: a world hour is 1920 ticks. By ten o'clock the administrator is at the computer, in its uniform, running the playzone

steps.shot: ten o'clock: the administrator at the central computer, the cabinets lit and waiting

steps.note: boredom takes six hours: by half past two in the afternoon the resident has gone to a cabinet and played a game on it, a quick one, and is amused
the day shift is over at four: the administrator goes home and nobody is left to run the playzone

steps.shot: half past four: the shift is over and the cabinets are dark

steps.note: the resident is bored again by eight in the evening and the playzone is dark, so it never plays: at nine o'clock it is thoroughly bored
